title: Norml Git
pitch: Make clear commits, preserve shared work, synchronize authorized remotes, and manage worktrees safely.
problem: A shared working tree can contain several people’s unfinished changes. A blanket commit or cleanup can lose ownership and local-only work.
This skill inspects history and actual files before changes, stages exact scope, and preserves evidence through synchronization and cleanup.

flow.d: Read instructions, status, history, remote identity and permissions.
Identify owned files and group commits by rationale.
Scan actual staged content and run applicable checks.
Apply only requested effects and verify the resulting SHA.
Retire a checkout only after history, file and consumer gates.

items: No automatic push, deployment or repository sweep.
The shared-claim adapter supports GitHub and isolated local test remotes; core Git/worktree procedures support other Git hosts.
Claims are cooperative bookkeeping, not editor or filesystem enforcement.
Merged history alone does not make a checkout disposable.

callout.label: Scope
callout.text: No automatic push, deployment or repository sweep.
